document.primary_goal: Recast the Library from a generated XOR-closure/answer-space interpretation into a static, eternally maximally complete totality whose maximality is structurally required by the absence of privileged worldlines and the observer's ability to establish an arbitrary relational reference within the whole.
source_priority: Three supplied PHYS-CORE-000 clarification note sets
Existing downstream terminology only where it does not conflict with the new Library interpretation

global_revision_thesis.old_risk: The current document can be read as though the Library is progressively generated by XOR closure and then filtered into observer-accessible coherent regions.
global_revision_thesis.new_position: The Library is a single static, eternally maximally complete totality. XOR supplies the primitive distinction operation and formal construction machinery, but traversal does not generate the Library and observer resolution does not determine Library membership.
global_revision_thesis.foundational_reason_for_maximality: No configuration or worldline is privileged as the universal origin of coherent traversal. If the observer may establish itself relationally at an arbitrary admissible configuration x ∈ 𝓜 while remaining related to the whole 𝓜, then coherent continuation must be recoverable from that arbitrary reference. A Library whose membership depended on a privileged construction history would make coherent continuation frame-dependent.
global_revision_thesis.observer_effect: Apparent temporal sequence, increasing complexity, locality, past/future distinction, and the experienced restriction of possible continuations arise from the observer's changing relation to the unchanged totality.
global_revision_thesis.no_intrinsic_time_partition: 𝓜 is not partitioned ontologically into past, present, and future.
global_revision_thesis.adjacency_principle: Configurations are members of one total relational structure; traversal ordering is observer-relative rather than an intrinsic temporal separation of Library regions.
critical_three_layer_separation: Γ_O(h_i,x), 𝓒(γ|O,h_i,x), A_O(h_i) = observer-relative structures over 𝓜

0.library.change_summary: Rewrite the foundational Library definition so maximality is explicitly tied to non-privileged worldlines rather than mere abundance of generated configurations.

modify.current_problem: The current formulation presents 𝓜 as the XOR closure of D and describes it as the smallest closed subset. This can imply that 𝓜 is generated progressively from a privileged initial substrate.
modify.new_form: Define 𝓜 as the complete static configuration totality of the NSFG construction. XOR closure remains part of its formal characterization, but closure must not be interpreted as temporal generation.
modify.exact_direction: State that the closure relation specifies formal membership/closure structure, not an ontological history by which the Library comes into existence.

modify.exact_text_direction: The Library is maximally complete because no configuration or worldline is privileged as the universal origin of traversal. Any admissible configuration may serve as an observer-relative reference point without changing the Library itself.
The Library does not evolve from simple to complex. It is maximally complete at every abstract traversal step: ∀i, 𝓜_i = 𝓜.
The observer is relationally situated with respect to the whole Library rather than being ontologically localized to a temporally generated neighborhood.
Past and future are not primitive subdivisions of 𝓜; they arise only as ordering relations within observer traversal.
Membership in 𝓜 must not be conditioned on coherence, observability, accessibility, persistence, physicality, relevance, or apparent temporal location.

remove: Any wording implying that closure is a temporal generation process.
Any wording suggesting that maximality exists merely to make the answer space sufficiently large.
Any implication that the Library begins in a simple state.
0.library.rationale: This is the conceptual foundation of all three note sets. The absence of a privileged worldline is the reason maximality is structurally required.
references: notes_n_clarifications-v0.1.0 / Library, timelessness, accessibility and resolution clarifications
0.library.poetic_cypher: The Library was never becoming. It was already whole.
0.library.cypher_explanation: The observer experiences a changing relation to the totality, but the totality itself does not undergo construction. Maximality is the condition that prevents any worldline from secretly becoming the Library's preferred history.
0.library.handoff: Every later subsection must treat 𝓜 as unchanged. Changes in observer state modify relations over 𝓜, never the membership of 𝓜.

3.1.change_summary: Separate formal closure from temporal generation and establish reference-frame neutrality.

modify.exact_direction: Explicitly state that Closure_D(⊕) is a mathematical closure construction, not a chronological process.
Do not allow the generating domain D or any chosen initial configuration to function as an ontological first state.
Any admissible x ∈ 𝓜 may become the observer's current relational reference without altering 𝓜.
If coherent traversal worked only from configurations associated with the construction origin, that origin would be an implicit privileged worldline.

remove: Temporal or developmental language attached to closure.
Any implication that the first generating configuration is the first physical/ontological state.
3.1.rationale: The primer must prevent a mathematical closure operator from being accidentally interpreted as cosmological evolution.
3.1.poetic_cypher: Closure draws no road through time; it names the room in which every road already lies.
3.1.cypher_explanation: Mathematical closure establishes structure without establishing a chronological creation story.
3.1.handoff: Section 3.2 must inherit 𝓜 as a static domain rather than reinterpret closure as an answer-generation mechanism.

3.2.change_summary: Replace the residual 'answer space' interpretation with complete static configuration totality.

modify.exact_direction: Where 'Unbounded Answer Space' is used ontologically, replace it with 'Unbounded Total Configuration Space' or explicitly define answer space as an observer-relative derived subset.
The Library contains configurations whether or not they are answers, coherent paths, observable states, or accessible states.
The observer does not search inside a pre-filtered answer space. It induces a relational structure over 𝓜.

remove: Any sentence implying that 𝓜 consists primarily of candidate answers.
Any equation in which observer accessibility appears to define Library membership.
3.2.rationale: The expanded Library concept is impossible to express consistently if the Library remains semantically equivalent to an answer space.
3.2.poetic_cypher: The Library is not the answers. It is the room in which answers can become relations.
3.2.cypher_explanation: The totality contains both coherent and incoherent configurations; coherence is induced only relative to an observer/reference.
3.2.handoff: All subsequent observer-relative subsets must be explicitly defined as subsets or relations over 𝓜, never as replacements for 𝓜.

4.1.change_summary: Extend the no-exterior argument from a closure trick into the deeper reference-frame argument.

modify.exact_direction: An external perspective does not create a privileged God's-eye coherence relation merely by being conceptually postulated.

Without an internally specified relation to 𝓜, an exterior perspective contributes no privileged internal organization and therefore encounters the totality as undifferentiated with respect to the model's internal coherence relation.
The argument is about the impossibility of a privileged external reference relation, not about literal physical randomness.

remove: Any wording implying that exteriority is simply physically impossible.
Any wording that equates lack of internal relational structure with literal randomness.
4.1.rationale: The new Library interpretation depends on reference being internal and relational rather than externally imposed.
4.1.poetic_cypher: Outside the Library there is no word by which the Library can be read.
4.1.cypher_explanation: The issue is not whether an imagined exterior exists; it is whether that exterior supplies a privileged coherence relation. It does not unless an additional relation is introduced.
4.1.handoff: Section 5 must now treat observer resolution as a relational property rather than a universal external measuring scale.

5.2.change_summary: Prevent observer resolution from becoming an ontological filter on Library membership.

modify.exact_direction: I_N(O) determines what distinctions observer O can maintain, not which configurations exist in 𝓜.
δ_O(x,y) < I_N(O) does not imply x = y and does not imply either configuration is absent from 𝓜.

remove: Any implication that resolution collapses Library ontology.
5.2.rationale: The observer effect must change experienced structure without changing totality.
5.2.poetic_cypher: The eye closes before the Library does.
5.2.cypher_explanation: Loss of distinction is a property of the observer's resolution, not deletion from the totality.
5.2.handoff: Section 6 must distinguish ontological membership, distinguishability, accessibility, and coherence.

6.1.change_summary: Explicitly separate distinguishability from ontological existence.

modify.exact_direction: State that observer-relative equivalence/indistinguishability is an epistemic/relational resolution relation over configurations already belonging to 𝓜.
x ≈_O y does not imply x = y and does not imply x or y are absent from 𝓜.

6.1.rationale: The static totality must remain intact while observer-relative structure changes.
6.1.poetic_cypher: Two shadows may merge without the things casting them becoming one.
6.1.cypher_explanation: Observer resolution collapses distinctions without collapsing ontology.
6.1.handoff: Persistence must be understood as maintained distinction across traversal, not ontological survival of configurations.

6.2.change_summary: Recast coherence explicitly as a relational structure induced over the whole Library from the current observer/reference state.

modify.reason: The current reference configuration x and history h must be explicit where relevant.

modify.exact_direction: Do not describe γ as intrinsically coherent or incoherent independently of observer/reference.
Coherence is evaluated against Path(𝓜), not against a locally generated neighborhood.
For every admissible x, the model requires Γ_O(h,x) to be nonempty above γ_noise.

6.2.rationale: This is the bridge between the static Library and observer-relative worldlines.
6.2.poetic_cypher: The whole is the field; the point is the question.
6.2.cypher_explanation: The Library supplies the total relational domain. The current reference determines which distinctions become coherent for this observer.
6.2.handoff: Section 8.1 should formally introduce the reference-point proposition that makes this relational continuation requirement explicit.

8.1.change_summary: Add Reference-Point Coherence Proposition and formally establish arbitrary observer-relative reference.

add.name: Reference-Point Coherence Proposition
add.formal: ∀x ∈ 𝓜_admissible, ∀(O,h) compatible with x, ∃γ ∈ Path(𝓜): γ begins at (h,x) ∧ 𝓒(γ|O,h,x) > γ_noise.

add.name: admissible reference configuration
add.requirement: Must be explicitly defined before the universal quantifier is used.

add.name: reference-frame neutrality
add.statement: Changing x changes the observer-relative relation but does not alter 𝓜.

modify.exact_direction: Introduce x as explicit relational reference parameter.
Present the proposition as a structural requirement derived from the combined NSFG assumptions, not as a theorem following from maximality alone.

8.1.rationale: This is the formal location where the key consequence of non-privileged worldlines becomes visible.
8.1.poetic_cypher: There is no first path. Any point may become the center, and the whole must still resolve into a path.
8.1.cypher_explanation: A privileged starting point would make coherent traversal an artifact of the construction origin. Reference-point neutrality forbids that asymmetry.
8.1.handoff: Section 9.1 must instantiate this proposition as the continuation relation over the unchanged Library.

9.1.change_summary: Redefine continuation as a whole-Library relational evaluation rather than a local future neighborhood.

modify.new_direction: Define candidate path space explicitly as a subset of Path(𝓜), with x as the current relational reference.

modify.formal: Γ_O(h,x) := {γ ∈ Path(𝓜) | γ extends h from x and 𝓒(γ|O,h,x) > γ_noise}

modify.exact_direction: Do not describe Γ_O as a neighborhood contained near x in an ontological sense.
Continuation is observer-relative ordering over the unchanged totality.

9.1.rationale: The observer's experienced worldline is a coherent subset of the Library's possible relational paths, not a path generated by a growing Library.
9.1.poetic_cypher: The path is not waiting nearby; the whole Library is already there.
9.1.cypher_explanation: The observer does not discover a little future-container adjacent to itself. It evaluates the whole totality from its current relational state.
9.1.handoff: Section 9.2 must distinguish existence of a coherent continuation from persistence of all candidate continuations.

9.2.change_summary: Preserve survivorship while removing any implication that the coherent subset defines Library membership.

modify.exact_direction: Survivorship determines which observer-relative transitions remain coherent, not which configurations belong to 𝓜.
The incoherent complement remains represented in the Library.
At least one coherent continuation is required from every admissible reference configuration, but not every candidate continuation is coherent.

9.2.rationale: This preserves the useful survivorship mechanism while preventing it from shrinking the ontology.
9.2.poetic_cypher: The Library keeps what the path does not.
9.2.cypher_explanation: Incoherence removes a transition from the observer's maintained worldline, not from the totality.
9.2.handoff: Section 10.1 must interpret navigation as traversal through surviving relational structure over 𝓜.

10.1.change_summary: Remove generated-future interpretation and define the next state as observer-relative ordering.

modify.exact_direction: Use 'continuation' or 'next ordered traversal position' rather than ontological future.
The successor is evaluated from the current reference against Path(𝓜).
Sequence index is ordering in traversal; it is not primitive physical time.
No step creates a new Library state.

10.1.rationale: The observer experiences succession, but the Library does not evolve.
references: DC-03 Why 'Always' Is the Correct Quantifier
10.1.poetic_cypher: There is no privileged next world; there is only the next coherent relation.
10.1.cypher_explanation: The ordering belongs to the observer's traversal, not to an ontological sequence of increasingly complete Libraries.
10.1.handoff: Section 10.2 must preserve 𝓜 as the unchanged domain of navigation.

10.2.change_summary: Make navigation operate over the static Library while changing only observer-relative relational position.

modify.exact_direction: N_O(h_n) selects/continues within Γ_O(h_n,x), where Γ is defined over Path(𝓜).
The observer's new state changes x and h, not 𝓜.
The observer's worldline is represented within the totality as a relational structure; traversal is the ordered experience of that structure.

10.2.rationale: This is where the 'observer occupies all points at once' interpretation must be expressed without introducing literal sequential creation.
10.2.poetic_cypher: The traveler changes places; the road does not become.
10.2.cypher_explanation: Navigation changes the observer's relational reference while the complete domain remains unchanged.
10.2.handoff: Section 12 must summarize navigation as a derived relational traversal over eternal totality.

12.change_summary: Rewrite the final dependency chain so maximality, non-privileged worldlines, observer occupancy, coherent continuation, and navigation form one explicit causal/logical architecture.

new_chain: observer relationally situated with respect to whole 𝓜

modify.exact_direction: State explicitly that maximality is structurally motivated by reference-frame neutrality, not merely by closure abundance.
Apparent growth from simple to complex is an observer effect over unchanged 𝓜.
Past/future are observer-relative traversal orderings, not Library partitions.

12.rationale: The final section must make the architecture impossible to misread as a generated-world model.
12.poetic_cypher: The whole is everywhere; coherence follows wherever the reference falls.
12.cypher_explanation: No point owns the Library. The observer's reference determines the currently experienced coherent structure, while the totality remains unchanged.
12.handoff: Downstream documents may introduce dynamics, cosmology, physical interpretation, or navigation mechanisms, but must inherit the distinction between static 𝓜 and observer-relative traversal.

notation_additions.h: Observer history relevant to current relational evaluation.
notation_additions.𝓜_admissible: Subset of Library configurations that can instantiate an observer-relative reference state under the model's admissibility conditions.
notation_additions.Γ_O(h,x): Observer-relative coherent continuation set from x given observer O and history h.
notation_additions.𝓒(γ|O,h,x): Coherence of traversal γ relative to observer, history, and reference x.
notation_additions.γ_noise: Minimum coherence distinguishable/sustainable by observer O under the relevant resolution condition.
notation_additions.𝓜_i: Notation to be used only to state invariance; not to imply actual temporal copies of the Library.

global_replacements.avoid: The Library is generated by closure.
global_replacements.replace: The Library is formally characterized by closure, but closure is not a temporal generation process.

global_replacements.avoid: The Library contains all possible futures.
global_replacements.replace: The Library is a static total configuration domain; observer traversal establishes ordered continuations within it.
Every admissible observer-relative reference configuration admits at least one coherent continuation.
The observer's experienced relational structure becomes more complex.
The observer's relation to the Library changes.

global_replacements.avoid: Past and future are regions of the Library.
global_replacements.replace: Past and future are observer-relative traversal orderings.

global_replacements.avoid: Coherence is intrinsic to a path.
global_replacements.replace: Coherence is evaluated relationally relative to observer, history, reference, and resolution.

global_replacements.avoid: The observer occupies a local region of the Library.
global_replacements.replace: The observer is relationally situated with respect to the whole Library while maintaining a restricted coherent continuation relation.

global_replacements.avoid: The Library is an answer space.
global_replacements.replace: The Library is the total configuration domain over which observer-relative answer/continuation relations are induced.

formal_changes.required_revision: Retain the closure relationship but explicitly distinguish mathematical closure from ontological generation and introduce maximal-static-totality as an independent invariant/semantic constraint.
𝓒(γ|O,h,x) where explicit reference dependence is required.
formal_changes.current_navigation: Γ_O(h_n) = {γ | γ begins with h_n and 𝓒(γ|O)=1}
formal_changes.required_revision: Γ_O(h_n,x_n) = {γ ∈ Path(𝓜) | γ extends h_n from x_n and 𝓒(γ|O,h_n,x_n) > γ_noise}
Retain A_O ⊆ 𝓜, but explicitly define A_O as observer-maintained relational accessibility rather than ontological locality.

must_be_derived_requirement: nonempty coherent continuation from every admissible reference configuration
must_not_be_claimed: maximality alone mathematically proves nonempty continuation
the Library itself possesses intrinsic temporal direction

cross_section_dependency_chain.0: Define static maximal totality and why maximality is structurally required.
cross_section_dependency_chain.3.2: Define total configuration space rather than answer space.
cross_section_dependency_chain.5.2: Make resolution observer-relative without changing ontology.
cross_section_dependency_chain.6.2: Define coherence as relational over whole 𝓜.
cross_section_dependency_chain.10.1: Define traversal ordering without generated futures.

highest_priority_editorial_rules: Maximality exists to eliminate hidden privileged worldlines, not merely to maximize the number of configurations.
The Library is maximally complete eternally.
The Library never progresses from simple to complex.
The observer is relationally situated with respect to the whole Library.
The observer's current reference point determines the experienced coherent subset, not Library membership.
There is no primitive past/future partition of the Library.
Continuation is ordered relative to traversal, not generated ontologically.
Every admissible reference configuration must have at least one coherent continuation under the model's assumptions.
Do not derive the previous statement from maximality alone.
Never collapse Library, observer state/history, and observer-relative coherent continuation into one object.

current_document_evidence: The current v0.1.0 explicitly defines 𝓜 := Closure_D(⊕), distinguishes Library membership from accessibility, defines observer-relative I_N(O), and defines coherence as 𝓒(γ|O). These are the structures being retained and reinterpreted rather than discarded.
downstream_reference: PHYS-CORE-012 should remain downstream and must not become a premise of the axiomatic floor.

overall_assessment.main_issue: The current mathematics is broadly usable, but several semantic interpretations are too weak or vulnerable to a generated-world/local-answer-space reading.
overall_assessment.most_important_repair: Make non-privileged worldlines the explicit reason for maximal eternal totality.
overall_assessment.second_most_important_repair: Make whole-Library observer occupancy the bridge between arbitrary reference and coherent continuation.
overall_assessment.third_most_important_repair: Make apparent temporal/complexity development an observer effect over unchanged 𝓜.
overall_assessment.fourth_most_important_repair: Explicitly distinguish the static Library from observer-relative traversal at every stage.
